description: ``aws configure agent-toolkit`` now configures the AWS MCP server in the configured region when it is one of the regions the AWS MCP server is available in (``us-east-1``, ``us-west-2``, ``ap-northeast-1``, ``ap-southeast-1``, ``ap-southeast-2``, ``eu-central-1``, ``eu-west-1``, ``eu-west-2``), and falls back to ``us-east-1`` otherwise.
